# Arlecchino Character & Theorycrafting Guide (KQM)

![Arlecchino](https://enka.network/ui/UI_AvatarIcon_Arlecchino.png)

## Overview & Playstyle
Arlecchino is a 5-star Pyro Polearm on-field DPS who utilizes the **Bond of Life** mechanic to convert her attacks into non-overrideable Pyro DMG and increase their damage scaling based on her current Bond of Life value.

### Core Mechanics & Bond of Life
- **Masque of the Red Death**: When Arlecchino's Bond of Life is equal to or greater than 30% of her Max HP, her Normal, Charged, and Plunging attacks convert to Pyro DMG.
- Each Normal Attack consumes 7.5% of her current Bond of Life and decreases Elemental Skill CD by 0.8s.
- **In-Combat Healing Restriction**: In combat, Arlecchino CANNOT receive healing from external sources (Bennett, Jean, Baizhu, etc.). She can ONLY be healed by using her Elemental Burst (*Balemoon Rising*).

## Talent Priority
1. **Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading** (Level 9 or 10 - Highest Priority, responsible for >80% of total damage output)
2. **Elemental Skill: All is Ash** (Level 8 or 9)
3. **Elemental Burst: Balemoon Rising** (Level 8 - Emergency heal and rotation reset)

## Stat Priorities & Desired Substats
- **Sands**: ATK% (or Elemental Mastery in Vaporize teams)
- **Goblet**: Pyro DMG Bonus
- **Circlet**: CRIT Rate or CRIT DMG
- **Substat Priority**: CRIT Rate / CRIT DMG > ATK% > Elemental Mastery (in reaction teams) > Energy Recharge (110-120% is sufficient).

## Recommended Artifact Sets
1. **Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy (4-Piece)**: Best in Slot (BiS). Grants +18% ATK and up to 54% all-damage bonus as Bond of Life increases/decreases.
2. **Gladiator's Finale (4-Piece)**: ~6-8% behind 4pc Whimsy. Excellent resin-efficient alternative with +18% ATK and +35% Normal Attack DMG.
3. **Gilded Dreams / Crimson Witch of Flames (4-Piece)**: Viable in dedicated Vaporize / Melt compositions.

## Weapon Rankings

![Crimson Moon's Semblance](https://enka.network/ui/UI_EquipIcon_Pole_BloodMoon.png)

1. **Crimson Moon's Semblance (5★)**: Signature weapon and BiS. Grants 674 Base ATK, 22.1% CRIT Rate, and 36-54% DMG bonus from Bond of Life.
2. **Staff of Homa (5★)**: 608 Base ATK, 66.2% CRIT DMG, reliable unconditional ATK buff.
3. **Primordial Jade Winged-Spear (5★)**: 674 Base ATK, 22.1% CRIT Rate, easy ATK% stacking.
4. **Deathmatch (4★ Battle Pass)**: 36.8% CRIT Rate, solid performance.
5. **White Tassel (3★ R5)**: Best F2P option. Grants 23.4% CRIT Rate and +48% Normal Attack DMG Bonus at R5.

## Team Compositions
1. **Vaporize**: Arlecchino + Yelan/Xingqiu + Bennett + Kaedehara Kazuha / Zhongli / Xilonen.
2. **Chevreuse Overload**: Arlecchino + Chevreuse + Fischl + Beidou / Bennett / Yae Miko.
3. **Mono Pyro**: Arlecchino + Bennett + Xiangling + Kaedehara Kazuha / Xilonen.
